title: The Crooked Shrine
description: Incense burns where no flame lives. The stone asks what memory you can spare.

choices.description: Heal 25% max HP, but take Dissonance.
choices.resultText: Warmth returns to your chest-lantern, and a discordant memory clings to your tongue.

choices.description: Lose 8 HP. Gain a random relic.
choices.resultText: The shrine drinks deeply. In return, it coughs up an old relic.

choices.description: Leave the shrine untouched.
choices.resultText: Not every vow needs answering.

title: Door With No Wall
description: A lone door stands in ash, frame and hinges attached to nothing.

choices.description: Fight what waits beyond. If you survive, gain an upgraded card.
choices.resultText: The threshold bites. Something inside takes offense at being found.

choices.description: Gain 1 Ward for next combat. Lose 5 Echoes.
choices.resultText: A polite knock earns a whispered blessing and an empty purse.

choices.description: Leave.
choices.resultText: You refuse to open what should not exist.

title: The Debt Keeper
description: A saintly merchant opens a ledger to a page already bearing your name.

choices.description: Gain 60 Echoes. Add Dissonance.
choices.resultText: Coins clatter into your palm. The debt settles in your ribs.

choices.description: Spend 40 Echoes to remove a card.
choices.resultText: The Keeper tears a page from your history.

choices.description: Gain Weak 1 next combat.
choices.resultText: The Keeper smiles. Refusal also accrues interest.

title: Blackened Casket
description: A sealed casket breathes in shallow, patient rhythms.

choices.description: Gain a relic. Take 10 damage.
choices.resultText: Wood splinters. Something ancient and useful crawls free.

choices.description: Gain a random rare card and a curse.
choices.resultText: The casket teaches you a forbidden pattern, then laughs.

choices.description: Gain 15 Echoes.
choices.resultText: You walk away richer and only slightly haunted.

title: Lanternless Child
description: A small voice asks for flame, though no face can be seen beneath the hood.

choices.description: Lose 20 Echoes. Gain Ward 1 and a random relic.
choices.resultText: The child bows. A relic is left in the ash where it stood.

choices.description: Reveal nearby routes and scout elite signs.
choices.resultText: Tiny fingers sketch paths in soot, and danger gains a name.

choices.description: Add a temporary Dissonance next combat.
choices.resultText: The silence behind you is accusatory.

title: Mirror of Old Skin
description: Your reflection wears a version of you that survived better.

choices.description: Transform a card.
choices.resultText: One memory peels off and returns as something new.

choices.description: Upgrade a card.
choices.resultText: You keep what works and sharpen it.

choices.description: Remove a card. Lose 6 HP.
choices.resultText: The mirror breaks. So does one of your old burdens.

title: The Hanging Bell
description: A bronze bell hangs from black rope. Its clapper is a tooth.

choices.description: Gain Strength 1 next combat. Gain Bleed 2.
choices.resultText: The bell answers from inside your ribs.

choices.description: Gain a relic. Add two Dissonance.
choices.resultText: The second toll draws blood from your ears and gifts from the dark.

choices.description: Heal 8 HP.
choices.resultText: Mercy, in this place, sounds like nothing at all.

title: Ash Garden
description: Dead flowers bloom in bursts of ember-light around your boots.

choices.description: Gain Burn Offering.
choices.resultText: You pluck a flower of heat and file it into memory.

choices.description: Heal 12 HP.
choices.resultText: Even cinders can cradle the tired.

choices.description: Start combat. If you survive, gain a relic.
choices.resultText: The garden screams and something predatory rises from the roots.
